items.title: Strength & Grounding
items.desc: Lava stone is formed under immense pressure and heat deep within the earth. That origin story translates into a powerful grounding energy — helping you stay rooted, calm, and centered.

items.title: Transformation
items.desc: Few symbols are more powerful than lava cooling into solid stone. It represents profound transformation — the ability to move through fire and emerge stronger, more defined, and beautifully new.

items.title: Connection to Nature
items.desc: Lava stone is one of the most natural materials you can wear. Porous, earthy, and deeply textured, it carries the memory of ancient forests and volcanic coastlines.

items.title: Protection & Courage
items.desc: Throughout cultures and centuries, volcanic stone has been revered as a protective talisman. Many believe it absorbs negative energy and fortifies the spirit.

steps.title: Handcrafted Assembly
steps.desc: Each bracelet is made by hand using durable, stretch-resistant elastic and secure finishing techniques. The result is a piece that is beautiful and built to last.

items.q: How do I care for my lava stone bracelet?
items.a: Lava stone is naturally porous and durable, but a little care goes a long way. Avoid prolonged exposure to water or harsh chemicals. To clean, simply wipe with a soft, slightly damp cloth and let air dry. Store in the pouch provided to prevent scratching from other jewelry.

items.q: Can I add essential oils to my lava stone bracelet?
items.a: Absolutely — in fact, it’s one of the most beloved features of lava stone. Because the stone is porous, it naturally absorbs and diffuses essential oils throughout the day. Simply place 1–2 drops of your chosen oil on the lava beads, allow a moment to absorb, and enjoy hours of subtle, natural aromatherapy.

Standard orders are typically handcrafted and shipped within 2–3 business days. Domestic delivery takes an additional 3–5 business days. We offer tracked shipping on all orders so you always know exactly where your bracelet is on its journey to you.

items.q: Do you accept returns or exchanges?
items.a: We want you to love your bracelet. If something isn’t right, reach out within 30 days of delivery and we’ll do our best to make it right — whether that’s an exchange, or a solution that works for you. Custom orders are final sale, but we’re always here to talk through any concerns.

quiz.title: The Gemstone Benefits Quiz
quiz.subtitle: Learn the meaning and benefits behind every stone — one question at a time.

questions.q: Lava stone is the heart of every Essential Gemstones bracelet. Why does it hold essential oils so well?
options: Its porous, volcanic texture absorbs and slowly releases oils
It is magnetic and attracts oil molecules
It is coated in natural plant extracts
questions.feedback: Lava stone forms from cooled volcanic lava, leaving it full of tiny pores that soak up essential oils like a natural diffuser — so you can carry a calming, grounding scent all day.

questions.q: What is the best way to use essential oils with your lava stone bracelet?
options: Soak the whole bracelet in oil overnight
Add 1–2 drops to the lava beads and let it absorb
questions.feedback: Just place one or two drops of your favourite oil on the porous lava beads, give it a moment to absorb, and enjoy hours of subtle, natural aromatherapy.

questions.q: Red Jasper sits at the base of the 7 Chakra bracelet. Which chakra does it align with?
questions.feedback: Red Jasper anchors the Root Chakra — grounding your spirit to the earth and bringing strength and a sense of security.

questions.q: What quality is Tiger's Eye best known for bringing?

questions.q: Turquoise is tied to which energy centre?

questions.q: Lapis Lazuli is chosen to support which of these?

questions.q: Amethyst crowns the 7 Chakra bracelet. What does it represent?
questions.feedback: Amethyst connects you to higher consciousness and spiritual protection — bringing peace and purifying your aura.

questions.q: In crystal lore, what does lava stone most symbolise?
options: Transformation — moving through fire and emerging stronger
questions.feedback: Born in fire and cooled into solid stone, lava represents profound transformation — the power to pass through hardship and emerge stronger and new.

questions.q: How should you care for your lava stone bracelet?
options: Scrub it with soap and hot water daily
Wipe gently with a soft damp cloth and avoid harsh chemicals
questions.feedback: Lava stone is durable but porous — wipe it with a soft, slightly damp cloth, avoid prolonged water and chemicals, and store it in its pouch.
